audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[N].side is flatlined to 'Skill' on every row while content win[] already correctly has Tristana for 1-3, Samira for 4-6 (levels), Tristana for 2+ items.
audit.why: Samira is melee-reliant pre-6 so Tristana's range wins outright; Blade Whirl (windwalls autos/E) plus Wild Rush dash-resets and the Inferno Trigger execute flip levels 4-6 hard to Samira; then Tristana's kite and reset punish overcommit late. None of that is a 50/50 skill coinflip.
audit.corrected: Set phases[0-2].side to Tristana, phases[3-5].side to Samira, phases[6].side to Tristana to match the already-correct content win[], rewriting each why to state the real reason.

audit.why: Content spikes already correctly mark levels 1-3 (range poke), level 6 (Inferno Trigger execute + Wild Rush stick), first item (Samira's lifesteal/attack-speed spike), and late (Tristana kites her out of dashes) as the swing points.

audit.whatIsWrong: suspectNames flagged 'Wild Rushes' vs 'wild rush' as a possible fabrication, but this is just the verb form of the real ability name Wild Rush (E) used in a sentence ("when she Wild Rushes onto you") — not a wrong name.
audit.why: Confirmed against enemyKit: E is named Wild Rush; the text correctly names it, only conjugated as a verb.

edits.before: Contest level 1 autos — your early range is real and the all-in threat starts at 2; set the tone.
edits.after: You win level 1 outright — Samira is melee-reliant and must close distance while you poke freely from range.

edits.before: Jump-bomb all-ins open: W in off any support CC and the E detonation math is already rude.
edits.after: Your range keeps denying her the CS she needs for combo stacks at level 2 — poke and hold the wave.

edits.before: Full kit: E the target, stack it with autos, and R the finish — the lane's most honest kill threat.
edits.after: Level 3 stays yours: Explosive Charge and auto poke punish her before her Blade Whirl spike comes online.

edits.before: Trade around the bomb: four stacks detonate — back off at three or commit at four; never linger between.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 flip to her: Blade Whirl nullifies your autos and E throw, and Wild Rush lets her stick to you.

edits.before: Buster Shot peels or executes — the knockback flips dives both directions.
edits.after: Level 6 is hers: Inferno Trigger executes any commit and her Wild Rush dash-resets beat your kite.

edits.before: First item spike: the jump-bomb-R string deletes squishies and the resets chain through fights.
edits.after: Her first-item spike is brutal — attack speed and lifesteal shred you while Blade Whirl eats your burst.

edits.before: Late Trist jumps the resets: E the carry, R the peel, and jump out — or in — on every takedown.
edits.after: This flips back: space her with Rocket Jump so she runs out of dashes, then delete her the moment she overcommits.

edits.before: E the bomb, stack two autos, and step back at three — the threat does the zoning and the fourth stack stays loaded.
edits.after: Four Explosive Charge stacks detonate — poke to two, then step back at three so you spend the fourth, not eat it.

edits.before: Jumping in with the bomb unstacked and R down — Tristana without the string is a yordle tourist at a gunfight.
edits.after: Buster Shot's knockback interrupts her combo before Inferno Trigger comes online — save it as the interrupt, not just the kill button.

edits.before: Commit on Blade Whirl’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your support’s setup. Make him flinch first.
edits.after: Commit on Blade Whirl’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your support’s setup. Make her flinch first.

edits.before: - Samira Blade Whirl: matchup-defining — Deletes every projectile for a second — hold your key shots until the whirl is spent. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Rocket Jump (reset) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Samira Blade Whirl (30-22s cd): matchup-defining — deletes every projectile for a second — hold your key shots until it's spent. Count it out loud. - Your W Rocket Jump (22-14s) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - Your R (100s) has one too: the moment it all goes right.
